ayahs.arabicText: اِذَا جَآءَ نَصْرُ اللّٰهِ وَ الْفَتْحُۙ
ayahs.translation: When the help comes from Allah, and victory (is granted),

ayahs.arabicText: وَ رَاَیْتَ النَّاسَ یَدْخُلُوْنَ فِیْ دِیْنِ اللّٰهِ اَفْوَاجًاۙ
ayahs.translation: and you see people entering Allah's religion in multitudes,

ayahs.arabicText: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَ اسْتَغْفِرْهُ١ؔؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ تَوَّابًا۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: then extol the praise of your Lord and pray to Him for forgiveness. For He indeed is ever disposed to accept repentance.
